Authentic Italian pizza in Vietnam? - Yes, it really exists!
Aug 2026 • Family
The cozy restaurant "Good morning Vietnam" is located approx. 70 meters from our extremely dreamlike accommodation "Cham Villas," which we booked for the period, and is situated on the Vietnamese coast in Mui Ne. The ristorante offers a very appealing and extensive selection of pizzas freshly made in a stone oven, Italian pasta, as well as Asian dishes. The choice is difficult, as one pizza tastes better than the next! After 3 weeks traveling through Hong Kong, Vietnam, and Cambodia, we were looking forward to Western dishes again in addition to the great Asian cuisine found in many places. During our 5-day stay in Mui Ne, after our first visit on day 1, we ended up here a total of 4 times in the evening, as it was incredibly delicious every single time. The pasta dishes of other guests also looked very promising (even if the portion size was a bit smaller), but our pizzas were so outstandingly good that, despite numerous visits, we couldn't bring ourselves to switch to pasta! The price-performance ratio is absolutely good. The pizza dough and the high-quality, fresh ingredients are absolutely authentic! That is certainly also due to the fact that the operator is likely from Italy. The staff is exceptionally friendly, also speaks English and, in part, German. There is also a delivery service with a corresponding takeout menu and the option to order via WhatsApp! In our opinion, the location is one of the culinary highlights on this stretch of coast, is worth at least one mandatory visit, and is highly recommended!
